blocks.prompt: 4. Determine the total worth of a yearly Rs. 5000 investment after 20 years if the interest rate is 5% compounded annually.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan sirf ek dafa paisa nahi lagaya gaya, balke har saal naye Rs. 5000 invest kiye jaate hain. Har deposit 5% compound interest par barhta hai, lekin har ek ko mukhtalif muddat milti hai: pehla 20 saal, doosra 19 saal, waghera.
Har deposit ki aakhri qeemat pichhle se 1.05 guna hai, is liye yeh qeematein G.P. banati hain, aur kul worth is G.P. ka jama hai.
Plan: har deposit ko saal ke shuru mein lagaya hua maanenge (answer key ka jawab isi se aata hai), har ek ki aakhri qeemat likhenge, aur G.P. sum ke formula se jama karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Har saal ke shuru mein Rs. 5000, 20 saal tak, 5% saalana compound.
Humein find karna hai: 20 saal baad kul worth \(W\).
Tareeqa: Har deposit ki aakhri qeemat \(5000(1.05)^k\) hai. Yeh G.P. hai, is liye \(S_n = \frac{a_1(r^n - 1)}{r - 1}\) lagayenge (\(r > 1\) ho to yeh form numbers ko positive rakhti hai).

Har deposit ki aakhri qeemat
\[\text{1st}: 5000(1.05)^{20}\]
\[\text{2nd}: 5000(1.05)^{19}\]
\[\ldots\]
\[\text{20th}: 5000(1.05)^{1}\]
Kyun: Pehla deposit saal 1 ke shuru mein laga, to poore 20 saal barha: 20 factors 1.05 ke. Doosra 19 saal, aur aakhri (20th) deposit saal 20 ke shuru mein laga, to sirf 1 saal barha. Har saal ka matlab ek 1.05 ka factor.

Kul ko G.P. ki tarah likhein
\[W = 5000(1.05) + 5000(1.05)^2\]
\[+ \ldots + 5000(1.05)^{20}\]
\[a_1 = 5250,\ r = 1.05,\ n = 20\]
Kyun: Terms ko chhote se bare ki tarteeb mein likha. Har term pichhle ka 1.05 guna hai, is liye yeh G.P. hai: pehla term \(5000 \times 1.05 = 5250\), ratio 1.05, aur kul 20 terms (20 deposits).

\((1.05)^{20}\) nikalein
\[(1.05)^5 = 1.2762815625\]
\[(1.05)^{10} \approx 1.62889463\]
\[(1.05)^{20} \approx 2.65329771\]
Kyun: Sawal 3 mein \((1.05)^5\) pehle hi nikal chuke hain. Usay square kiya to power 10, phir dobara square kiya to power 20. Calculator ho to seedha \(1.05^{20}\) bhi nikal sakte hain.

Kul worth nikalein
\[W \approx 105000 \times 1.65329771\]
\[\approx 173596.26\]
Kyun: Bracket mein \(2.65329771 - 1 = 1.65329771\), phir 105000 se multiply kiya: taqreeban Rs. 173596. Asal mein jeb se sirf \(20 \times 5000 = 100000\) diye gaye; baqi taqreeban 73596 munafa hai.
Dhyan dein: agar deposits saal ke aakhir mein lagte to aakhri deposit ko koi munafa na milta aur kul \(5000 \cdot \frac{(1.05)^{20} - 1}{0.05} \approx 165329.77\) hota. Book ka jawab 173596 saal ke shuru wale deposits se aata hai.
